Actual Article Body:
Republicans have every reason to be nervous about November. But after spending the past two days at the Nixon Foundation’s Grand Strategy Summit, I regained some hope. Our 37th president reminds us that Republicans not only have the power to win elections, but to beat the left decisively, as long as we understand what made Richard Nixon so popular in the first place.

Now, “Nixon” and “popular” don’t really go hand in hand in the public imagination. But Nixon is having a new moment online. A generation that was previously taught that there is nothing more to Nixon than Vietnam and Watergate is taking a second look.

The post Federal Judge Blocks Trump’s Border Wall Construction Across Texas’s Big Bend Sector appeared first on Breitbart.

Actual Article Body:
A federal judge on Friday halted the Trump administration’s border wall construction across Texas’s Big Bend sector despite federal officials’ warnings that barriers elsewhere could push illegal crossings into the region.

U.S. District Judge Kathleen Cardone issued the injunction in El Paso after local residents and preservation advocates sued to stop the project. The order blocks construction and related work throughout the Big Bend sector, including Big Bend National Park, while the lawsuit proceeds.

Trump announces $90 checks for 20 million ‘wonderful seniors’ to help cover Medicare premiums

Actual Article Body:
Switch between CA and NY editions here.

See more of our coverage in your search results.

President Trump announced Friday that over 20 million “wonderful seniors” will receive $90 checks this month to help cover Medicare premiums.

Eligible Medicare Part B enrollees will receive the one-time payment via direct deposit or check thanks to  the Medicare Improvement Fund that was established in 2008, according to the White House.

Trump called the Medicare Improvement Fund, “a pointless ‘Slush Fund’ that has only been used by Dumocrats in Congress to pay for the Waste, Fraud, and Abuse for their Special Interest friends, and drive up Healthcare costs.

“We are finally using this Fund, along with my Most Favored Nations Deals, to substantially LOWER costs for our Seniors,” the president said in a Truth Social post.

Over 20 million senior citizens are said to benefit from Trump’s one-time payment.
